name: Sacred Gear Mods
author: kirides
description: Mods for Sacred Gold on the Sacred Gear mod kit of SacredBild: a better savegame screen, autosave, loot tools, a chat window, companions, custom classes, quests and clients of the SacredEngineRemake game server. Extract the zip into the game folder.

mods.name: Achievements and login streak
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: Toasts for the achievements and the daily login streak of the game server's achievements.lua (Sacred.GameServer scripts-examples), and a panel listing them with progress. Needs that server; the original GameServer.exe does not talk to mods.

mods.name: Art bars
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: More combat arts at hand than the game's skill bar holds: extra bars of slots for your hero's combat arts and spells (copies and chains of the Custom classes mod too), with keys, cooldowns and the controller. Single player.

mods.name: Auction house
mods.author: kirides
mods.description: Buy and sell items with the other players of a game, from the chest window. The host keeps the market.

mods.name: Autosave
mods.author: kirides
mods.description: Saves the game every few minutes of play into its own slots.

mods.name: Better SaveLoad
mods.author: kirides
mods.description: The savegame screen made new: hero, class, level and picture of every savegame, filters by character and class, a search, several orders, and room for thousands of savegames (the game stops at 100 on its own screen). Works with the mouse, the keyboard and the controller.

mods.name: Bounty board
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: Bounties to hunt, plus daily and weekly quests with streak rewards: in single player the mod posts, counts and pays them itself, in a network game it shows the board of a Sacred.GameServer with scripts-examples/bounty_board.lua. Panel and a small tracker.

mods.name: Build sharer
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: Publish your hero build to the game server and browse the builds other players shared. Needs the Sacred.GameServer of the SacredEngineRemake with scripts-examples/build_sharer.lua; the server reads your skills and equipment itself, this mod only sends a title, a note, tags and the items you carry.

mods.name: Companions
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: A party of heroes in single player: recruit companions of any class, each with their own inventory, equipment, attributes, skills, combat arts and experience. Click a portrait (or use the controller's mod menu) to play that hero; the others follow and fight on their own, with their combat arts and spells.

mods.name: Custom classes
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: Heroes with a class of your own: a Seraphim body with Battle Mage fire, a Gladiator that casts. A class is a profile on one of the eight hero bodies (skills, arts from any class, runes) made with the Sacred Class Editor or by hand. Needs the mod on every computer in a LAN game.

mods.name: Damage meter
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: Damage dealt and taken by the hero (from the engine's final damage of every hit), DPS over the fight and the last seconds (compact view by default: character name and DPS, the whole party in a network game), the biggest hit, damage by monster type, kills per minute.

mods.name: Drop tuning
mods.author: kirides
mods.description: Makes creature drops more or less frequent, tilts the rarity of the equipment they drop, can swap the game's random numbers for a fair generator, can let the Icon Set pieces and the pieces of the X-MAS set of your class drop at any level, and can make creatures drop the gear you could otherwise only take with the Disarming skill.

mods.name: Enhanced Chat
mods.author: kirides
mods.description: A chat window in place of the lines at the top of the screen that fade and are gone: it keeps the last lines of the session to scroll back through, has tabs for global, private and system messages (and a filter by player in a network game) and shows item names in their rarity colour, also for the drops near your hero. Move it with the layout editor, set its size in the settings. Mouse, keyboard and controller.

mods.name: Item comparison
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: Hover an item (backpack, chest, shop, the pad's cursor too) and a panel beside the game's tooltip shows what it changes compared with the item your hero wears in that slot: green for better, red for worse. Optionally for your companions too.

mods.name: Key bindings
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: Choose the keys and mouse buttons of the game's actions (weapons, combat arts, potions, windows), two keys each, with an optional quick cast for combat arts.

mods.name: Layout editor
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: Move the game's windows and mod panels where you want them: an edit mode like an MMO's.

mods.name: Loot filter
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: Picks up only the items you want: by class, quality and category; dims the rest on the ground.

mods.name: Loot log
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: A log of the items that dropped near the hero and the items that ended up in the backpack, filterable by quality, category and kind; kept between sessions.

mods.name: Name editor
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: Build character names with the game's colors and little pictures: type, pick colors and icons, or color a name with a gradient, and copy the raw text (\cffRRGGBB colors, \gffffffff00000XXX icons) that Sacred stores. Pasted raw names are read back. The same editor also runs as a web page (docs/name-editor).

mods.name: Quest helper
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: A panel with the quest items in your backpack (read here) and the quest records of your hero, with hints, which the game server reports (Sacred.GameServer with scripts-examples/quest_helper.lua and hero data). Limits: neither Gear nor the server can read the game's quest journal.

mods.name: Realm
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: Choose the online play server (realm) for Closed / Open Internet: a page in the mod manager. Realms are kept in mods/gear_realms.json.

mods.name: Region counter
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: The kills a region needs before its Region Boss quest comes: set your own number, and keep the progress when you leave the region, teleport, save or quit.

mods.name: Sacred theme
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: The look of the game for the RmlUi screens of the other mods: the thick frame, game buttons, check orbs, sliders, tab bars, scroll bars and the controller prompts. Gear puts its stylesheet in front of every RmlUi document. The mods do not need it: without a theme they use the plain base style of Sacred Gear and look plainer; this one gives them the look of the game.

mods.name: Server feed
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: Shows the announcements of the SacredEngineRemake game server on screen: rare and unique drops (scripts-examples/rare_drops.lua) and hero deaths (graveyard.lua), and a list of the latest of both. Does nothing on a server without those scripts.

mods.name: Session tracker
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: Time played, kills, gold and experience gained this session, with per-hour rates; lifetime totals and the last sessions are kept.

mods.name: Shared stash
mods.author: kirides
mods.description: A stash shared by all your heroes, in a panel beside the chest window.

mods.name: Spawn rate
mods.author: kirides
mods.description: Multiplies the creatures the game spawns, from 1x (the game as it is) up to 100x. Every hostile creature around you, those the world creates and those already there, brings extra ones of its kind with it. Single player only; safeguards keep the frame rate up.

mods.name: Sprite browser
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: Every UI image of the game in a grid with its number, in the mod's page of the Mods screen. The numbers are the N of the .sprite-N classes of the Sacred theme and of gear:image/N: a quick lookup for modders. Click a picture to copy its class.

mods.name: Twitch Integration: actions
mods.author: Sacred Gear
mods.description: Twitch viewers spawn monsters, give gold, heal or teleport the hero.

mods.name: World events
mods.author: kirides
mods.description: Shows the game server's world event (a realm-wide goal such as "slay 1000 orcs in 2 hours") as a small movable indicator (a pill with progress and time rings). Needs a Sacred Gear game server with the world_events script.
